The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on August 30, 2024, approved Buyback of 5,00,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value of  Rs. 10/- each at a price of Rs. 1000/- per equity share (being 1.69% of the total paid up equity capital of the Company) for an aggregate consideration not exceeding Rs. 5,000 Lacs (excluding transaction cost and any other expenses incurred for the buy back) representing 4.97% and 4.96% of the aggregate of the paid up share capital and free reserves (including securities premium) as per the audited standalone and consolidated financial statements respectively as on March 31, 2024.       Further, on the settlement date i.e. September 30, 2024, Company has made payment of Rs. 5,000 Lacs to those shareholders of securities whose offer has been accepted. The issued capital of the Company pre-buyback was 2,95,97,837 and post-buyback is 2,90,97,837. However, as on September 30, 2024, the number of shares remain 2,95,97,837 as the same were extinguished on October 05, 2024.
